text:
Here's everything you need to know before Thursday's opening bell : 

Apple ( AAPL ) said its overall contribution to the U.S. economy will top $350 billion over the next five years. Tesla ( TSLA ) rallies on glowing Model 3 reviews. China's economy grew by 6.9% in the final 3 months of 2017, faster than expected.  Verizon ( VZ ) said the tax law allowed it to book a gain of nearly $17 billion in its 4th quarter earnings. U.S. stock futures suggested a lower open following another record-setting day.  Watch More with TheStreet :
